reports.title: Arista Networks, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: For the fourth quarter of 2026, we expect:
•Non-GAAP diluted net income per share of $1.26 - $1.30.

desk.headline: Revenue up 58.5% to $3.66bn, beat; Q4 outlook $3.9–4.0bn above estimates
results: Revenue jumped 58.5% to $3.66bn, the fastest growth since its stock-market listing, and well above the company's own $3.3bn target.
Product sales rose to $3.19bn from $1.91bn; service revenue grew to $468m.
Net profit rose 83% to $1.56bn. GAAP EPS of $1.22 was helped by a $135m gain on investments; adjusted EPS was $1.20.
Gross margin slipped to 64.0% from 65.2% (adjusted), but operating margin edged up to 49.1%.
Inventory rose to $3.21bn and deferred revenue to $6.84bn; no shares were bought back this year.

guidance.summary: For Q4 Arista expects revenue of $3.9–4.0bn, adjusted operating margin of 48–49% and adjusted EPS of $1.26–1.30. On the call it lifted its 2026 revenue view to about $13.3bn (the fourth raise this year) and gave a first 2027 view of about $18.5bn.

points: Management set a first 2027 target of about $18.5bn, with data-centre networking for artificial intelligence expected to double to about $7bn.
The CEO flagged industry-wide parts shortages; purchase commitments rose to $11.4bn from $9.7bn and inventory to $3.2bn.
Three, possibly four, customers are each expected to supply at least 10% of revenue, so sales remain concentrated.
Rising component costs weigh on gross margin; 2027 gross margin is guided at 62–64% with operating margin near 49%.
The finance chief said deferred revenue swings a lot and is not guided, though she expects it higher at year-end.
call.source: Call transcript (The Motley Fool, 4 Nov 2026); Investing.com and 24/7 Wall St. coverage, 3 Nov 2026
